name: Trivia
description: Quiz rounds with scores: play AeroTrivia on its page, or ask the bot to quiz you in chat. Kids mode, and room for questions of your own.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.stats: Trivia scores so far: games played, the average score, the best score, the last game, and the score of a round going in chat.
tools.list_categories: List the trivia question categories and how many questions each has.
tools.ask_question: Ask the next multiple-choice trivia question of a round in chat: the question and options A to D. The answer is kept back until check_answer. A round does not repeat a question until the category runs out.
tools.check_answer: Check a guess at the question just asked: says if it is right, gives the answer, and keeps each player's score for the round.
tools.end_round: End the trivia round played in chat and save each player's score.
tools.record_result: Save the score of a trivia round played some other way: how many answers were right out of how many.
tools.add_question: Add a question of your own to the trivia bank, for the game page and for chat. A category that is not on the list becomes a new category.
tools.remove_question: Remove a question you added to the trivia bank.

ask_question: ask the kids an easy trivia question
end_round: that's enough trivia, save our scores
record_result: save our trivia round: we got 7 out of 10 right in history
add_question: add a trivia question: what is our dog's name, the answer is Biscuit
remove_question: take my question about the dog out of trivia

consent: Trivia keeps your scores and any questions you add in its own data folder on this computer. Its other questions come with it. It does not use the internet.
